glance: Nvidia posted a record $115.8B quarter, but shares fell 2.9% as the board ruled out bringing back Jensen Huang as CEO.
Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share, valuing it near $1.5 trillion; ANT starts trading on Nasdaq today.
Google launched Gemini 4 Neon, a mid-tier model it says leads several coding and agent benchmarks.
Officials told Congress the recent string of US tech outages, including FAA and NSA systems, were unrelated and not cyberattacks.
Trump, Xi and Putin are set to hold their first-ever three-way summit today in Shenzhen at APEC.

tech.headline: Nvidia beats big, but the CEO saga weighs on the stock
tech.summary: Nvidia reported $115.8 billion in quarterly revenue, more than double a year ago and well above estimates, with the new Vera Rubin platform contributing nearly $20 billion. It guided to about $130 billion next quarter (assuming no China data center sales) and raised its fiscal 2028 growth outlook to 75%. Shares still fell 2.9% Wednesday after leadership said Jensen Huang, who resigned Nov. 12 over code-of-conduct issues, will not be reinstated; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent chief.

tech.headline: Anthropic prices record IPO at $83 a share
tech.summary: Anthropic priced its shares at $83, above the $70 to $78 marketed range, valuing the Claude maker at roughly $1.5 trillion fully diluted, up from $965 billion in May. CNBC reports the offering raised more than $81 billion, the largest on record, ahead of SpaceX's listing. Shares begin trading today on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT, alongside a separate $26 billion private placement from major tech companies.

tech.headline: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Neon
tech.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Neon, a middle tier between its top Carbon model and the fast Hydrogen model, across the Gemini API, Antigravity and the Gemini app for paid subscribers. Google claims it ranks first on an independent coding-agent index and has its lowest-ever fabrication rate in internal tests. It is priced at $3 per million input tokens with a 1-million-token context window, and a cyber-defense variant is going to vetted security teams.

tech.headline: AI-discovered NGINX flaw lets attackers take over servers
tech.summary: Security firm Xint used AI models to uncover five flaws in NGINX, one of the web's most widely used server programs, including an unauthenticated remote-code-execution bug dating to 2015 that works on default settings. F5, which maintains NGINX, began issuing patches Wednesday and urged immediate updates; Wiz says it found the same flaws independently. Researchers estimate millions of exposed servers could be vulnerable.

tech.headline: Palo Alto Networks buys AI startup Applied Compute for $4.5B
tech.summary: Palo Alto Networks agreed to acquire Applied Compute in an all-stock deal worth about $4.5 billion, extending its push into AI-driven security. The company also beat first-quarter revenue estimates and raised its full-year forecast, sending shares higher after hours.

tech.headline: Microsoft puts Word, Excel and PowerPoint inside Copilot
tech.summary: At its Ignite conference, Microsoft made the core Office apps generally available directly inside Copilot, pitching the assistant as the main interface for work. It is a further step in reorganizing Microsoft 365 around AI agents rather than standalone apps.

tech.headline: White House weighs making companies disclose Chinese AI use
tech.summary: The Trump administration is considering a rule that would require US firms to disclose when they use Chinese-made AI models. Separately, Tencent's president said new US limits on remote access to advanced chips will slow AI training in China, and House Democrats opened a probe into Commerce Secretary Lutnick's family ties to Nvidia.

other.headline: Officials: recent outages were not a coordinated attack
other.summary: At a House Homeland Security hearing, DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin, DNI Jay Clayton and the FBI said a run of outages, including an FAA ground stop, bank and Microsoft service failures, and an NSA network outage, stemmed from separate maintenance and technical changes. The FBI said it found no sign of malicious cyber activity.

other.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen
other.summary: Xi Jinping personally greeted President Trump on arrival in Shenzhen for the APEC summit, and the two are set to hold a first-ever trilateral meeting with Vladimir Putin today. Trade, arms control, Ukraine and Iran are expected on the agenda.

other.headline: Dow drops 561 points; Nasdaq edges up
other.summary: The Dow fell 1.1% to about 50,198 for a third straight loss, the S&P 500 slipped 0.2% and the Nasdaq gained 0.4% as AMD and Broadcom rose while Nvidia lagged. The 10-year Treasury yield remains above 5%, and investors are watching Anthropic's debut today.

other.headline: Peltola wins Alaska Senate race; Jeffries nominated for Speaker
other.summary: Democrat Mary Peltola defeated Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan roughly 50% to 46%, becoming the first Indigenous woman from Alaska elected to the Senate and widening the Democratic majority. House Democrats nominated Hakeem Jeffries for Speaker in the next Congress.

other.headline: Cost-of-living protests sweep France
other.summary: About 146,000 people joined peaceful demonstrations across France over rising living costs, including students and some private-sector workers.
